parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the returned task details include alert rules. Valid values:

true: Alert rules are returned.

返回的任务详情是否包含报警规则。

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

ComparisonOperator.description_en:
The threshold comparison operator of the alert rule. Valid values:

`>=`
`>`
`<=`
`<`
`=`
`!=`
GreaterThanYesterday: the metric value is greater than the value at the same time yesterday.
LessThanYesterday: the metric value is less than the value at the same time yesterday.
GreaterThanLastWeek: the metric value is greater than the value at the same time last week.
LessThanLastWeek: the metric value is less than the value at the same time last week.
GreaterThanLastPeriod: the metric value is greater than the value in the previous cycle.
LessThanLastPeriod: the metric value is less than the value in the previous cycle
ComparisonOperator.description_zh:
报警规则的阈值比较符。取值：

`>=`
`>`
`<=`
`<`
`=`
`!=`
GreaterThanYesterday：同比昨天同时间上涨。
LessThanYesterday：同比昨天同时间下降。
GreaterThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间上涨。
LessThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间下降。
GreaterThanLastPeriod：环比上周期上涨。
LessThanLastPeriod：环比上周期下降

Dimensions.description_en: The dimensions associated with the alert rule

Expression.description_en: The expression of the alert rule

ErrorCodeMinimum：所有状态码（组合报警）。
Average：响应时间

OptionJson.description_zh: 扩展选项。每一种探测类型有不同的扩展类型，详情请参见[CreateSiteMonitor]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115048.html）

operator.description_en:
The assertion comparison operator. Valid values:
contains: contains.
doesNotContain: does not contain.
matches: matches a regular expression.
doesNotMatch: does not match a regular expression.
is: equals a numeric value or matches a string.
isNot: does not equal.
lessThan: less than.
moreThan: greater than
operator.description_zh:
断言比较操作符。取值：
contains：包含。
doesNotContain：不包含。
matches：正则匹配。
doesNotMatch：正则不匹配。
is：数值等于或字符匹配相等。
isNot：不等于。
lessThan：小于。
moreThan：大于

property.description_en:
The parsing path of the assertion content.

If the assertion type is `body_json`, the path is a `json path`.

If the assertion type is `body_xml`, the path is an `xml path`
property.description_zh:
断言内容解析路径。

如果断言类型为`body_json`，则路径为`json path`。

如果断言类型是`body_xml`，则路径为`xml path`

target.description_en: The target value or string for the assertion comparison
target.description_zh: 断言匹配比较的目标数值或字符

type.description_en:
The assertion type. Valid values:
response_time: checks whether the response time meets expectations.
status_code: checks whether the HTTP response status code meets expectations.
header: checks whether a field in the response header meets expectations.
body_text: checks whether the content in the response body meets expectations using text string matching.
body_json: checks whether the content in the response body meets expectations using JSON parsing (JSON Path).
body_xml: checks whether the content in the response body meets expectations using XML parsing (XPath)
type.description_zh:
断言类型。取值：
response_time：判定响应时间是否符合预期。
status_code：判断HTTP响应状态码是否符合预期。
header：判定响应Header中的字段是否符合预期。
body_text：通过文本字符匹配判断返回Body中的内容是否符合预期。
body_json：通过JSON解析（JSON Path）判断返回Body中的内容是否符合预期。
body_xml：通过XML解析（XPath）判断返回Body中的内容是否符合预期

The matching rule for DNS. Valid values:

IN_DNS: all expected aliases or IP addresses are included in the DNS response.
DNS_IN: all DNS responses are included in the expected aliases or IP addresses.
EQUAL: the DNS response exactly matches the expected aliases or IP addresses.
ANY: the DNS response and the expected aliases or IP addresses have an intersection

DNS的匹配规则。取值：

IN_DNS：期望解析的别名或IP地址均在DNS应答中。

EQUAL：DNS应答和期望解析的别名或IP地址完全相同。
ANY：DNS应答和期望解析的别名或IP地址有交集

dns_server.description_en:
The IP address of the DNS server.

This parameter applies only to DNS monitoring
dns_server.description_zh:
DNS服务器的IP地址。

仅适用于DNS探测类型

dns_type.description_en:
The DNS resolution type. This parameter applies only to DNS monitoring. Valid values:
A: the IP address corresponding to the specified hostname or domain name.
CNAME: maps multiple domain names to another domain name.
NS: specifies the DNS server that resolves the domain name.
MX: points the domain name to a mail server address.
TXT: the description of the hostname or domain name. The text length is limited to 512 bytes. This type is commonly used for SPF (Sender Policy Framework) records to prevent spam
dns_type.description_zh:
DNS解析类型。仅适用于DNS探测类型。取值：
A：指定主机名或域名对应的IP地址。
CNAME：将多个域名映射到另外一个域名。
NS：指定域名由某个DNS服务器解析。
MX：将域名指向一个邮件服务器地址。
TXT：主机名或域名的说明。文本长度限制512字节，通常用做SPF（Sender Policy Framework）记录，即反垃圾邮件

parser_type.description_en: The extraction mode for the variable. Valid values: 0 (JSON), 1 (XML), and 2 (regular expression)
parser_type.description_zh: 提取变量的模式。0为json，1为xml，2为正则

value.description_en: The variable extraction expression. When the extraction mode is JSON or XML, the expression supports XML format. When the extraction mode is regular expression, the string that matches this value is extracted
value.description_zh:
变量提取表达式
提取方式为json和xml时，变量提取表达式支持xml格式。
提取方式为正则表达式时，提取和该值匹配的字符串

is_critical.description_en: Specifies whether a failure in the current step marks the entire monitoring task as failed. Default value: false
is_critical.description_zh: 如果当前步骤失败，则会标记整个探测为失败。默认值为false

option.description_en: The extended options for the step. Each monitoring type has different extended options. For more information, see [CreateSiteMonitor]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115048.html）
option.description_zh: 该步骤的扩展选项。每一种探测类型有不同的扩展类型，详情请参见[CreateSiteMonitor]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115048.html）

step_type.description_en:
The monitoring type for the step. Valid values:
http
ping
tcp
udp
dns
smtp
pop3
ftp
wait

The wait type is a wait step
step_type.description_zh:
该步骤的拨测类型。可选类型有
http
ping
tcp
udp
dns
smtp
pop3
ftp
wait

其中wait为等待步骤

url.description_en: The URL for a single step in multi-step monitoring
url.description_zh: 多步拨测中，单步拨测的url

use_generated_cookie.description_en: Specifies whether to use cookies extracted in previous steps. Default value: false
use_generated_cookie.description_zh: 是否使用该步之前提取出的cookie。默认值为false

trace_region.description_en: The deployment region of the target application when integrating with Managed Service for OpenTelemetry
trace_region.description_zh: 设置与可观测链路OpenTelemetry版本集成时，目标应用的部署地域

trace_type.description_en:
The Tracing Analysis protocol used when integrating with Managed Service for OpenTelemetry. Settings:
OpenTelemetry
Zipkin
Jaeger
trace_type.description_zh:
设置与可观测链路OpenTelemetry版本集成时，使用的链路追踪协议。
可选值为
OpenTelemetry
Zipkin
Jaeger

traffic_hijack_element_blacklist.description_en: When a redirect occurs, if the URL of a resource loaded by the browser matches any expression in this list, traffic hijacking is considered to have occurred
traffic_hijack_element_blacklist.description_zh: 当发生重定向时，如果浏览器加载资源的URL与该列表中的表达能匹配，则认为发生流量劫持

items.description_en: When a redirect occurs, if the URL of a resource loaded by the browser matches any expression in this list, traffic hijacking is considered to have occurred
items.description_zh: 当发生重定向时，如果浏览器加载资源的URL与该列表中的表达能匹配，则认为发生流量劫持

traffic_hijack_element_count.description_en: When a redirect occurs, if the number of resources loaded by the browser exceeds this value, traffic hijacking is considered to have occurred. If this value is set to 0, no check is performed. Default value: 0
traffic_hijack_element_count.description_zh: 当发生重定向时，如果浏览器加载资源数超过这个值，则认为发生流量劫持。当该值为0时，不进行校验，默认值为0

traffic_hijack_element_whitelist.description_en: When a redirect occurs, if the URL of a resource loaded by the browser does not match any expression in this list, traffic hijacking is considered to have occurred
traffic_hijack_element_whitelist.description_zh: 当发生重定向时，如果浏览器加载资源的URL与该列表中的任意一个表达式都不匹配，则认为发生流量劫持

items.description_en: When a redirect occurs, if the URL of a resource loaded by the browser does not match any expression in this list, traffic hijacking is considered to have occurred
items.description_zh: 当发生重定向时，如果浏览器加载资源的URL与该列表中的任意一个表达式都不匹配，则认为发生流量劫持

use_private_crt.description_en: Specifies whether to use a private certificate

use_ssl.description_en: Specifies whether to use an SSL connection when running a TCP task
use_ssl.description_zh: 执行TCP任务时是否进行SSL连接
use_ssl.title_zh: 执行TCP任务时是否进行SSL连接

username.description_en: The username for FTP, SMTP, or POP3

waitTime_after_completion.description_en: The additional wait time after a page is opened in a browser-based detection task
waitTime_after_completion.description_zh: 浏览器拨测任务中，页面打开后的额外等待时间

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the monitoring task

TaskName.description_en: The name of the monitoring task

TaskState.description_en:
The status of the monitoring task. Valid values:

1: enabled.
2: disabled
TaskState.description_zh:
监控任务的状态。取值：

1：启用。
2：禁用

TaskType.description_en: The type of the monitoring task. Site monitoring supports the following task types: HTTP(S), PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, and FTP
TaskType.description_zh: 监控任务类型。目前站点监控任务的类型包括：HTTP（S）、PING、TCP、UDP、DNS、SMTP、POP3、FTP

VpcConfig.description_en: The VPC configuration of the internal network detection task
VpcConfig.description_zh: 内网拨测任务的VPC配置信息

Region.description_en: The region where the target site of the internal network detection task is located
Region.description_zh: 内网拨测任务的目标站点所在地域

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group to which the internal network detection task is restricted
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 该内网拨测任务受限于的安全组id

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the internal network detection task is attached
VpcId.description_zh: 该内网拨测任务挂载的vpc id

VswitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the internal network detection task is attached
VswitchId.description_zh: 该内网拨测任务挂载的vswitch id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
